info.title: nwunif
info.description: nwunif is a CLI application to perform Univariate Forecasting on your own values. Time Series Forecasting is a machine learning technique that aims to predict the next values in a time series when a subset of subsequent values is provided.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Command-line application to perform univariate forecasting tasks.

commands.name: session
commands.description: Groups all the features related to a single forecasting session.

commands.name: forecast
commands.description: Forecasts the next x values for the provided init file.

options.name: --init
options.description: The filename of the JSON file containing the initialization data. The file needs to be stored in the working folder.

options.name: --folderpath
options.description: The path of the working folder. If not specified, '<path>' will be used.

options.name: --savesession
options.description: If provided, the forecasting session will be saved as JSON in the working folder.

options.name: --roundingdigits
options.description: When coefficient and error are not provided by the user, they are generated and rounded. If not specified, '15' will be used.

options.name: --forecastingdenominator
options.description: 'Y_Forecasted = 0' is a totally legit value. To avoid a 'divide-by-zero' error, we replace it with a comparably small amount while forecasting. If not specified, '0.00000000000001' will be used.
